prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. This is a PRODUCTION LAYER for the same 2D game sprite, NOT a new design or pose. Make the complete EMPTY level4 nest frame behind its plant. Remove ONLY the four central ivory flower petals, golden bean and small green sprout with its two leaves. Preserve ALL rigid architecture and foreground foliage: exact circular ivory stone platform, steps, leaf keystone pillars, bronze side support arms with their original pin and collar placements, left turquoise pressure vessel and pipe, the complete dome with gold ribs and green crest, lower seven-leaf rosette, curled green side vines, and brown center cradle cup. Paint the newly exposed background surfaces behind the removed flower as a COMPLETE continuous pale turquoise painted-glass dome interior and complete pale stone deck behind the cradle. Restore every previously hidden joint, upper clamp back, inside face, rim and floor surface so no cut-out gaps remain. NO ivory flower fragments anywhere in the empty center. Do not replace the plant by another object. No doubled brace, pin or rim. Keep original thin dark contours, painted texture, palette, camera, scale, all margins and original 512-square coordinate placement (baseline 448, center 259) proportionally if output is larger. The empty frame stays one complete isolated rigid construction on a TRUE transparent background, no shadow, glow, smoke, lettering, annotations or grid.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Produce one PRODUCTION PARTS ATLAS of SIX complete isolated rear-plant parts, for the exact two reference game sprites. Transparent background. Three columns by two rows, one part per cell, generous clear gaps, no text or borders. TOP ROW from left: complete level3 LEFT pointed rear ivory petal; complete level3 RIGHT pointed rear ivory petal; complete level3 golden bean body, its three original rounded golden lobes attached together, no green stem or ivory petal. BOTTOM ROW: the corresponding complete level4 LEFT pointed rear ivory petal; complete level4 RIGHT pointed rear ivory petal; complete level4 golden three-lobe bean body. Draw the ENTIRE full silhouette and surface of each part, including all lower roots and inner edges that are hidden by the front curled petals or golden bean in the references. Rear petals have pointed ivory tops and sage-green shading toward the rounded lower root, not front-petal spiral curls. Each is ONE continuous clean full teardrop-like petal, with its original left/right lean and no unrelated green leaf, wood, brass, socket or background pixels stuck to it. Gold bean contains no V-shaped line copied from the foreground petal occlusion. Preserve exact reference anatomy, painted texture, ivory/sage/gold palette and thin dark teal contour. These are actual replacement hidden-surface layers that will be used to rebuild the same approved keyposes; do not invent a new design, no pose sheet, no assembled nest, no shadows or effects.
